title: CoinFlipModern
description: A modern CoinFlip plugin featuring high-fidelity animations
body:
### CoinFlipModern - The Ultimate Gambling Experience

Bring the thrill of the coin toss to your server! CoinFlip is a lightweight, high-performance gambling plugin designed with a modern touch and beautiful animations.

# ✨ Key Features
- Modern GUI: Fully customizable interface with smooth item transitions.
- Animation System: Exciting coin-spinning animation in the GUI to build suspense!
- Smart Pagination: Automatically handles dozens of active bets with easy-to-use Next/Back buttons.
- Vault Integrated: Works seamlessly with any economy plugin via Vault.
- ⚙️ Full Configurable: Tweak every message, sound, and item.
Commands & Permissions
- /cf - Open the CoinFlip menu.
- /cf <amount> - Create a new bet.
- /cf reload - Reload all configurations (Permission: coinflip.admin).
️ Installation
1. Download and drop the .jar into your plugins folder.
2. Ensure you have Vault and an Economy plugin (like EssentialsX) installed.
3. Restart your server and enjoy!
Why choose CoinFlip?
Unlike other plugins, we focus on efficiency. No more "ghost bets" or lost money during lag. Everything is handled with care for your server's performance!
